Hi Procurement / Marcus / Sarah,

Thanks for the clear asks. A legal / tax recap and proposed language:

1) Net terms: Redwood can approve Net45 for this customer subject to a one-time 1.25% pricing uplift on the committed units (applies to invoice amounts for the first year). We will issue invoices referencing the PO number and accept PO-led invoicing.

Proposed contract language (Order Form, Invoicing section):
"Invoices shall be issued in accordance with the schedule set forth in the Order Form. Customer shall provide a valid PO number at signature. Payment terms are Net45. For customers electing Net45, a one-time pricing uplift of 1.25% shall apply to committed units for the first contract year."

2) Invoicing cadence: Redwood can issue an activation invoice at signing and subsequent invoices per quarter. We can also provide consolidated monthly statements upon request; invoices will reference PO and detailed line items.

3) Taxes: For EU-registered customers providing a valid VAT number and reverse-charge statement, Redwood will not charge EU VAT on the invoice (reverse charge applies). If CloudSight later requests Redwood to charge VAT, Redwood may require additional documentation.

Proposed contract language (Taxes section):
"If Customer provides appropriate tax residency and VAT registration documentation prior to invoicing, Supplier will not charge VAT and Customer will be responsible for any applicable reverse-charge obligations in its jurisdiction. Supplier reserves the right to request additional evidence of tax residency."

4) MSA vs Order Form: Standard practice at Redwood is that the MSA is executed once and the Order Form references and relies on the MSA. We will route the (MSA + Order Form) via DocuSign; the Order Form is effective upon execution by both parties.

Action items:
- Marcus: confirm acceptance of 1.25% uplift for Net45 (Ben to confirm forecast impact).
- Sarah/Procurement: please send VAT registration and specify desired invoice recipient (ap@cloudsight.com or alternate).
- If all OK, I will prepare a short amendment paragraph for the Order Form and send a DocuSign packet (MSA + Order Form).

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Privacy | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps so we dont lose momentum: 

1) Net45: Redwood approves Net45 with a one-time 1.25% uplift on committed units for year 1. Ben validated the uplift; impact is ~0.9% on expected ARR (Ben, please send the note to Sarah offline).
2) Commit phasing: Redwood will accept quarterly tranche schedule with activation invoice at signature + three quarter-start invoices.
3) Invoice routing: Redwood will send invoices to ap@cloudsight.com and include the PO on each invoice line; CloudSight may request consolidated monthly statements as an optional deliverable.
4) VAT: CloudSight to provide VAT registration and reverse-charge documentation prior to first invoice; Redwood will not charge EU VAT where reverse charge applies.
5) Execution: Kim will include the Net45 uplift clause and the invoicing cadence paragraph in an amendment to the Order Form. Well send (MSA + Order Form + amendment) via DocuSign for signatures.

Sarah / Procurement — if the above matches your expectations, please confirm and well push the DocuSign today. If you want a brief call, Im free Monday 9–11am PT.
